ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 25,000+ reviews, but 0 of 30 live ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get no reason to trust the claim. Put 25,000+ reviews on the creative, and open two ads with a review quote.

The offer sits after 96% of the copy on a median ad of 228 words, so readers rarely reach it. Your site promotes a guarantee that 0 of 30 ads mention. Open each ad with the guarantee in its first two lines.
The median ad runs 228 words and the longest runs 358, so the hook gets buried under a wall of text. Cut every ad to two lines and the offer, and move the feature list to one line.

Your 30 ads open 18 different ways, and the biggest opener leads only 4 of them, so no story gets room to win. Pick the two best stories from your longest running ads and build the next batch from them.
